decision_semantics.ADMITTED: Meets every frozen admit threshold and has no structural rejection reason.
decision_semantics.HOLD: Structurally usable but below one or more admit thresholds without crossing a frozen reject floor, or policy is still draft.
decision_semantics.REJECT: Structurally unusable or crosses at least one frozen reject floor.

notes: Do not replace this draft with arbitrary round numbers. Freeze thresholds only after reviewing the real candidate distribution from training_data_eligibility.json/review.csv.
A calendar year is evidence, not an admission rule. fixed_start_year must stay null/false unless a future canonical data contract explicitly requires one.
Final training selection must preserve the common temporal split and must not choose per-plant test windows after looking at performance.
